entry.title: Show HN: A local-first AI agent for the desktop, no Electron, any LLM endpoint (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Hey folks. Most all the apps I see for agent harnesses are typescript based, and involve either electron or some form of IPC to function as a desktop app. In the age of LLM's, I thought it would be cool to build out a prototype of what a modern desktop application would like for this, without using any web code, since I can have agents pretty aggressively work on the cross-platform compatibility on my behalf. After about a week, I ended up with a harness that feels pretty good! Feel free to try it from the releases or you can install directly via: ``` cargo install byob ```` Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50507341 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
